description: This file defines a custom hook 'useLeaveValidators' for handling leave validation logic in a Human Resource Management system. It includes functions for serializing leave data into request payloads, validating overlapping leaves, and checking leave balances via API calls.

methods.name: serializeBody
methods.description: Converts a LeaveModel object into a LeaveRequestBody payload suitable for API submission, handling duration and partial options.

methods.name: serializeParams
methods.description: Prepares query parameters for API requests based on LeaveModel, including handling of durations and partial options.

methods.name: validateOverlapLeaves
methods.description: Checks for overlapping leave entries via API call, returning conflict status and overlapping data.

methods.name: validateLeaveBalance
methods.description: Retrieves and calculates the leave balance for a given leave type via API call.
